{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping NaNs
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the full series to capture all values
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify the species with the highest mean
best_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
best_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

# Print the final answer and value
print(f'Best species: {best_species}')
print(f'Best value: {best_value}')"}
